children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 1, 2026) - Naia Relief Inc. (formerly, 1329308 B.C. Ltd.) (the "
") announces that it has changed its name to "Naia Relief Inc." (the "
") and has completed a share consolidation on the basis of 9.0363 pre-consolidation common shares for one (1) post-consolidation common share (the "
") effective September 1, 2026. The Name Change and Consolidation have been completed in connection with the Company's business combination with Relief AI Inc.

The new CUSIP number for the common shares of the Company will be 62881H106 and the new ISIN number will be CA62881H1064. Following the Consolidation, the Company will have approximately 2,499,994 common shares issued and outstanding. No fractional common shares will be issued as a result of the Consolidation, such that fractional common shares will be rounded down to the nearest whole number.

Registered shareholders holding share certificates of the Company will be mailed a letter of transmittal from the Company's transfer agent, TSX Trust Company, advising them of the Name Change and the Consolidation and instructing them to surrender and exchange their share certificates or Direct Registration System (DRS) statements evidencing their pre-consolidated common shares for new share certificates or new DRS statements representing the number of post-consolidated common shares to which they are entitled. Non-registered shareholders holding common shares of the Company through an intermediary (a securities broker, dealer, bank or financial institution) should be aware that the intermediary may have different procedures for processing the Consolidation than those that will be put in place by the Company for registered shareholders. If shareholders hold their common shares of the Company through intermediaries and have questions in this regard, they are encouraged to contact their intermediaries.
